rationale: Shared pipeline: label-aligned regex census, balanced factorial template generator, F.g OLS ratios to topic, true logits for ambiguous cells, greedy 16 latents under topic cap, sample ablation, regex BA. A adds a true-vs-proxy slope/residual diagnostic and topic-disjoint decompositions; ranks latents by design shifts. B uses 32 minimal pairs (2SE) blended with true-pair shifts, single flips plus topic flip, peak tokens.

Both settle an ambiguous proxy OLS cell with a true-logit topic x property 2x2 on one fixed template and take the main-effect ratio. B first single-flips two candidates, rejecting a proxy-only one, then completes the 2x2; A runs one 2x2 directly. Latents: A design-based shift x gradient under a 20% cap; B minimal-pair (2SE) plus true-pair shifts, sign-consistent.
